name: OneShot

overview.text: OneShot presents a business-agent execution platform for long-running goals, individual tools, spending limits, approvals and signed receipts. Its homepage advertises 174 tools and a catalog of 213 vendors across 30 categories, explicitly including planned integrations. Those totals do not mean every vendor integration is active. Examples cover research, messaging, purchasing, logistics, filings and physical tasks. The enterprise offer is a paid four-week pilot scoped by agreement; execution guarantees, customer logos and security badges are vendor claims, not independent proof of performance.
